verdict.rationale: Restate workflows are ordinary handler code written with SDKs for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go and Rust. Wrapping a step in `ctx.run`/`run` persists its result in the execution log, and code automatically resumes from completed steps after failures. A community user confirms adding the TS SDK to an existing app, and code runs as normal services in the user's own process. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of the step checkpointing and recovery behaviour, and no explicit doc statement contrasting this code-first approach with YAML or DSL definitions.
